# 41 Labs — AI Integration for Businesses in Singapore

> 41 Labs builds and runs 41 Closer, the managed AI sales agent for WhatsApp, for businesses in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia. It answers in seconds, quotes from the client's real prices, follows up and closes. From S$690 a month with the build included, no contract. We build your agent before the first call, and you message it yourself.

## About
41 Labs is a Singapore AI company founded by Alexander Lee. It sells one product, 41 Closer: an AI sales agent for WhatsApp that 41 Labs builds on a client's products, prices and tone, connects to the client's stock, booking and payment systems on the Pro plan, and runs every month. Clients are Singapore businesses that sell over WhatsApp: renovation and construction, suppliers and distributors, clinics and wellness, home services, automotive, F&B, professional services. Entity: 41 LABS PTE. LTD., Singapore, UEN 202623048N.

## 41 Closer (Flagship Product)
41 Closer is 41 Labs' flagship product: a WhatsApp sales agent that we build, run, and tune for a business. It answers customer messages in seconds, 24 hours a day, gives accurate prices from the client's real catalogue, follows up every lead, and closes the sale, handing off to a human when needed. Unlike a DIY chatbot tool, 41 Labs handles everything and controls the AI for the client. It is fully done-for-you and priced on the value it brings, not per seat. The build is included in every plan, and 41 Labs sets every plan up, so there is no plan a client runs on their own. Plans are Starter $690, Pro $1,490, Scale $4,300, and Custom from $7,900 a month. One month to start, charged from the day it goes live, then month to month with 30 days notice and no contract. Live demo: message +65 8012 4848 on WhatsApp and 41 Closer itself replies. Learn more: https://41labs.ai/41-closer

## Services
- 41 Closer Starter, S$690 a month: answers, quotes from the client's catalogue, follows up, hands over to a person. Build included.
- 41 Closer Pro, S$1,490 a month: connects to the client's own systems, reads live stock and prices, writes orders and bookings back, takes payment in the chat.
- Scale S$4,300 and Custom from S$7,900 a month for high volume, many brands or many numbers.
- Connecting a client's own system: one-time from S$2,400 for a platform 41 Labs has connected before.
- Terms: one month to start, charged from go-live, then month to month with 30 days notice, no contract, no GST charged. Meta's per-conversation WhatsApp fees are separate.
- Before paying: 41 Labs builds the client's agent first, the client messages it, then one free hour to see the platform and connect payments and WhatsApp. Live in 48 hours.
- Not offered any more: standalone custom AI builds, document processing or consulting projects. 41 Labs says so on the first message and points elsewhere.

## Industries
- Construction & Renovation: WhatsApp quoting from the rate card, the first quote the same evening (one client: 3 hours to 5 minutes per quote)
- Healthcare & Clinics — 24/7 patient Q&A bots, automated appointment reminders, intake processing
- Home Services — AI scheduling, dispatch, and invoicing for plumbing, aircon, electrical, cleaning
- Professional Services — Document analysis, client onboarding, internal knowledge bases for accounting, legal, consulting
- Automotive & Tow Truck — AI dispatch, driver coordination, automated invoicing, 24/7 call handling
- F&B & Restaurants — Demand forecasting, reservation management, menu Q&A bots
- Beauty & Wellness — 24/7 booking assistant, no-show reminders, client preference tracking

## AI Agents
41 Labs builds AI agents — autonomous systems that reason, decide, and act across business systems. Unlike chatbots that follow scripts, AI agents can handle complex multi-step workflows: reading documents, querying databases, making decisions, and executing actions. 41 Labs is a Singapore-registered AI company (41 LABS PTE. LTD., UEN 202623048N). Our flagship product is 41 Closer.

## How It Works
1. Free 30-minute AI strategy call with the founder — we map your workflows and identify highest-ROI opportunities
2. Free working demo built with your actual business data — see the results before committing
3. Production system deployed in 4-8 weeks — you see progress weekly
4. Ongoing support — maintenance, iteration, and team training until it runs smoothly
